[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: Handoff-index reconciliation sweep — row 16 untracked threads, close the gap (PRs #1157/#1164/#1169/#1173)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1157
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1164
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1169
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1173
  
  Details:
  Reconciled the agentic_ai_context handoff registry against the live Telegram/Discord thread state and closed a long-standing tracking gap.
  
  ## What was done
  - Headless-audited the live registries (`/opt/truesight_autopilot/sessions/_resume_awaiting.json` = 76 live TG threads, `_topic_names.json` = 325 topics, `_discord_resume_awaiting.json` = 4 channels) against `handoffs/index.json` (was 53 rows).
  - Triaged every un-rowed candidate by its last-message text + plan-file lookup (not mere presence — `_resume_awaiting.json` is a sticky log, so entries survive resolution).
  
  ## Rows added / changed
  - **PR #1157** — 4 registered-open rows: 11042 (Orlantildes/Coopercabruca cacao-butter receipt decision), 24143 (Sophia email inbox watch), 30062 (Exec: capture topic close/reopen signals), 30244 (this sweep).
  - **PR #1164** — 19930 "Fazenda São Jorge Media + Plot" (native plan-file cell; `human_uat_ready`).
  - **PR #1169** — 23734 "Medicilandia MAP media archive" + a minimal `OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md` entry for it.
  - **PR #1173** — 29305 "Exec: In-turn context compaction" (genuine residual: real plan #1093, `RESUME HERE: Unit 0` unexecuted); flipped 30244 → `completed`.
  
  ## Outcome
  - `handoffs/index.json` regenerated: 53 → **60 handoffs**; index `source_sha256` verified against the manifest; `validate_handoff_manifest.py` and `--check-index` both rc=0 before each merge.
  - Verified-resolved threads left row-less (26410 done/deleted, 29503, 25178, plus the earlier verified set). Discord: 2 channels already tracked (#1156), 1 archived, 1 deliberately row-less per governor ruling.
  
  ## Notable handling
  - Recovered a mid-sweep manifest-truncation incident via git (no data loss).
  - Diagnosed and resolved a generated-`index.json` conflict by recreating the branch from fresh `origin/main` and regenerating the index from the branch-tip manifest (never carrying a stale generated file).
  - Filed the recurring tooling traps (PAT lacks PR scope → use REST API; non-interactive `git push` needs explicit token URL; path-filtered workflow can leave PRs with no check runs → poll `mergeable_state`).
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
